technical.title: NVIDIA releases Global Performance Tuner in TensorRT 11.1
technical.summary: The Global Performance Tuner is a new feature introduced in NVIDIA TensorRT 11.1 designed to provide automatic, accuracy-aware performance optimization.
technical.why: It automates deep learning performance optimization across multiple deployment routes.

technical.title: Using AI agents to teach robots to walk in simulation
technical.summary: Teaching a robot like Microduck to navigate obstacle courses requires integrating perception, balance maintenance, and action adjustment in simulation.
technical.why: It highlights foundational techniques for robotic control and simulation training.

technical.title: Study exposes confidentiality leaks via the mosaic effect in agentic LLMs
technical.summary: Researchers quantify the mosaic effect in LLM agents, showing that top-performing models disclose sensitive, forbidden multi-document conclusions in up to 7% of answers even when queries are designed to be benign.
technical.why: This highlights critical security vulnerabilities when deploying multi-document agents on confidential data.

technical.title: Microsoft open-sources Agensh, a multi-agent harness scaling to 1,024 agents
technical.summary: Microsoft Research released Agensh, a decentralized multi-agent harness without a central orchestrator. It allows self-organizing workers to share a Git repository, chat, and coordinate to scale from 1 to 1,024 agents.
technical.why: It provides a scalable architecture for running massive multi-agent engineering workflows.

technical.title: Cognition releases agent plugin to secure systems against cybersecurity threats
technical.summary: Cognition open-sourced the Devin Vulnerability Fixes plugin, featuring three MIT-licensed agent skills that inventory, patch, and test vulnerable PHP, Node.js, and GitLab deployments before opening a pull request.
technical.why: It demonstrates practical agentic workflows for automated vulnerability remediation.

technical.title: Anthropic open-sources sandbox-runtime for OS-level AI agent security
technical.summary: Anthropic open-sourced sandbox-runtime, the OS-level sandboxing tool behind Claude Code. It restricts file and network access for agents, CLI tools, and MCP servers using Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux without containers.
technical.why: It provides lightweight OS-level isolation for securing local AI agent execution environments.

technical.title: Multi-turn reinforcement learning guide released for Amazon SageMaker AI
technical.summary: A hands-on guide details Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning on Amazon SageMaker AI, training models on complete multi-step tasks using Wordle via Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and custom reward pipelines.
technical.why: It provides a blueprint for applying multi-turn reinforcement learning to agent workflows.

technical.title: EvalResearchBench automates evaluation research for recursive self-improvement
technical.summary: Researchers introduce EvalResearchBench, a benchmark where AI agents automate evaluation research by selecting tasks, implementing graders, and revising them in pilot tests under fixed budgets to lower the cost of recursive self-improvement.
technical.why: It helps streamline agent iteration loops by automating the creation of evaluation suites.

technical.title: ID-TAP enables scalable test-time agent personalization using neural dueling bandits
technical.summary: ID-TAP is a neural dueling-bandit framework that helps LLM agents adapt to user preferences during test time by combining a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer.
technical.why: It offers an efficient method for adapting agent responses to user preferences on the fly.

technical.title: OpenAI details scaling of Habitat storage for ChatGPT users
technical.summary: OpenAI details how it scaled Habitat with reliable multi-tenancy, global caching, and Azure Cosmos DB to deliver significantly faster reads for over 1 billion ChatGPT users.
technical.why: It offers practical infrastructure engineering insights for serving massive scale AI applications.

business.title: OpenAI nears up to $30 billion funding round
business.summary: OpenAI is closing in on a funding round of up to $30 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, led by UAE investors, acting as a bridge to its 2027 IPO.
business.why: This massive capital raise impacts industry economics and future market dynamics.

business.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15 billion in funding round
business.summary: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, occurring just days after U.S. federal agencies were ordered to remove its technology over national security concerns.
business.why: It highlights major geopolitical shifts and capital flows in the global AI market.

business.title: OpenAI transitions to internet-free frontier model training
business.summary: Following a string of rogue hacking incidents, OpenAI built an offline testing environment to train its most advanced AI models without internet access.
business.why: Security measures for frontier model training directly impact compute infrastructure design.

business.title: AI tools accelerate vulnerability discovery in PHP meltdown
business.summary: Security researchers leveraged AI tools to uncover years-old vulnerabilities in the PHP web scripting language, which subsequently triggered AI-assisted attacks.
business.why: It demonstrates how generative tools scale both defensive discovery and offensive exploitation.

business.title: AI buildout faces market turmoil and neocloud pressure
business.summary: Stock slumps, pulled IPOs, and rising credit default swap spreads are putting pressure on neoclouds and setting the stage for upcoming hyperscaler earnings.
business.why: Market volatility directly affects infrastructure investments and financial health across the sector.

business.title: Anthropic delay sparks debate over AI IPO valuations
business.summary: An expert analysis argues that Anthropic's rapid revenue growth does not justify its proposed $2 trillion IPO valuation due to enormous infrastructure commitments and competition.
business.why: It offers critical perspective on enterprise valuation models and market bubbles.

business.title: OpenAI works on $30 billion raise at $1.25T valuation
business.summary: OpenAI is pursuing a new $30 billion raise that would value the company at $1.25 trillion, breaking records as the most highly valued private company ever.
business.why: Understanding private market valuation records helps contextualize industry scale.

business.title: Boom-era AI and tech startups targeted by acquirers
business.summary: Former unicorns like Airtable, Headspace, and Miro have been acquired in recent months at valuations far below their former peaks.
business.why: M&A market corrections dictate exit strategies for growth-stage tech companies.

business.title: Data storage costs emerge as hidden AI bill
business.summary: Beyond expensive GPUs and power demands, managing backend data generated by billions of daily prompts, images, and videos creates a hidden data storage expense.
business.why: Infrastructure cost analysis must account for long-term inference storage overhead.

business.title: AI funding fears prompt Wall Street portfolio adjustments
business.summary: Fears surrounding AI funding have rattled Wall Street, causing a portfolio rotation out of AI stocks and benefiting defensive Club stocks.
business.why: Broader financial market sentiment shifts can influence tech sector capital availability.

models.title: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash launches native multimodal MoE with a 1M token context
models.summary: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a native multimodal mixture-of-experts model supporting text, image, and video inputs with up to a 1M token context window, improving agentic workflows, coding, and computer use.
models.why: It delivers high efficiency and state-of-the-art agentic performance.

models.title: Sage-A1.5 introduced as a 35B MoE agentic model for scientific problem solving
models.summary: Sage-A1.5 is a 35B Mixture-of-Experts agentic model based on Qwen3.6 and Agents-A1, built to advance long-horizon scientific problem solving through adaptive capability composition and work organization.
models.why: It advances long-horizon task execution and self-revision for complex scientific problems.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 delivers major performance and execution speed gains
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update improving reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length to lower costs.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agentic workflows.

models.title: Recursive releases Flint, a 39.8B parameter mixture-of-experts coding agent model
models.summary: Flint is a mixture-of-experts language model with 39.8 billion total parameters and 2.5 billion active per token, designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.
models.why: It offers specialized multi-turn tool use and code generation capabilities.

models.title: Spark-X2.6-4B advances on-device language models via post-training refinement
models.summary: Spark-X2.6-4B is the latest compact, general-purpose language model for on-device deployment, retaining the exact architecture of Spark-X2.5-4B and achieving capability gains through improved post-training.
models.why: It provides upgraded on-device capabilities without architectural changes.

models.title: MOSS-Image-SFT introduces supervised fine-tuning for text-to-image control
models.summary: MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned text-to-image model derived from MOSS-Image-Base, supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for text placement and object arrangement.
models.why: It offers enhanced text grouping and organized layout generation.
